about: The go-live checklist rules. scripts/readiness_checks.py reads this file, so change an expected event, field, word list or status here and nowhere else. Pixel issue rates and feed job health are rated by data-feed-health's own rules, not here. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.default_stage: prelaunch or live. Before launch, a check with no traffic or events yet is AMBER (expected, but must be seen before go-live); after launch it is RED. --stage overrides it.
notes.pixel_launch_types: Discovery pixel types a site needs at launch. Each must have events (RED or AMBER by stage if not). Issue rates are rated with data-feed-health's rules, not here.
notes.pixel_optional_types: Pixel types reported as in use or not in use, never red: needed only if the site uses that page or widget.
notes.discovery_product_fields: For each basic product field, the Discovery catalog attributes that can hold it; the first one with a value counts as filled.
notes.discovery_required_fields: Fields every product needs for search, category pages and the grid. A fill rate below field_fill_red is RED, below field_fill_amber AMBER. Other fields in discovery_product_fields are at most AMBER.
notes.field_fill_red: See discovery_required_fields: the share of sampled products with the field filled.
notes.searchable_red: Reserved attributes that must be searchable: not searchable is RED.
notes.searchable_amber: Reserved attributes that should be searchable: not searchable is AMBER.
notes.min_facetable_custom_attributes: Fewer custom attributes than this set to facetable (auto or manual) is AMBER: shoppers get few filters.
notes.api_request_types: Discovery API request types to look for, by name, with the get_discovery_api_requests filter for each. No requests is RED or AMBER by stage.
notes.engagement_core_events: Engagement events a store needs, each with the names a project may use for it (aliases), the properties to look for and whether it is required. A missing required event is RED; a missing optional one, or missing properties, AMBER; an event defined but never received (used false) is RED or AMBER by stage.
notes.welcome_flow_words: Words in a scenario name that mark a welcome flow, matched lower-case.
notes.cart_flow_words: Words in a scenario name that mark a cart abandonment flow; all of them must appear (abandon and cart).
notes.missing_flow_status: Status when no welcome or no cart abandonment scenario exists.
notes.inactive_flow_status: Status when the flow exists but none is active (draft, inactive or paused).
notes.owners: Who usually fixes each kind of check: developer, merchandiser or CRM.
